Story.heading: About Castler
Story.intro: Castler is an architectural design studio working across architecture, interiors, and urban design to create environments where the built form connects deeply with the people who use it.
paragraphs: Founded by Otabek Isoqjonov, Castler is based in Tashkent and works across residential, commercial, and public projects, from early concept through construction. The studio approaches each project through its relationship to site, climate, and the people who will use it.
